description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure request idempotence. Generate a unique value for this parameter from your client. **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and cannot be more than 64 characters long.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenest rollback-service-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-instance-id si-d6ab3a63ccbb4bxxxxxx --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
